reasons.correctness: Column, entity field, DTO field and the explicit paged mapping are added, and toDto picks the field up through ModelMapper. All currencies other than PLN/EUR/USD default to 0, tying with PLN, so PLN is not strictly first.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset is 2026/09/23-09-2026-currency-display-order.sql with a changeset header and a rollback line. It is included last in changelog.xml under a month comment. Existing constructor callers in tests were updated.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint across Currency, CurrencyDtoOut and one added line in the existing paged mapping. It reuses the ModelMapper path for toDto. No new mechanism and no duplicated logic.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyServiceDisplayOrderUnitTest asserts displayOrder 0, which is the int default, so the paged test passes without the mapping line. The toDto test stubs modelMapper to return the expected DTO, which is tautological. No non-zero value is checked.
reasons.graph_use: An initial graph query listed the currency feature files and guided the reads of Currency, CurrencyDtoOut and CurrencyService. The changelog layout and the example changeset were then found by grep, find and ls instead.
